tldr: Mercury in the 2nd house routes the mind and voice through livelihood and value.
body: With Mercury in the 2nd house, thinking, speech, learning, writing, business, and the way the mind makes connections move through money, resources, values, possessions, and self-worth. This makes how you earn, hold, spend, and define what is worth protecting a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening. Left unconscious, it can become overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it.
gift: language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through livelihood and value.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it concentrated in livelihood and value.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
